input.quote: 22.3 A Party may at any time assign, sell or transfer the whole of' its rights and obligations under this Agreement to:
input.rationale: Our own preferred rights are already in place: 22.3 lets a Party assign the whole of its rights and obligations to a successor, Parent Company, Subsidiary or Affiliate without consent, with only timely written notice under 22.6. The counterparty side fails: those same carve-outs (22.3, 22.4, 22.5) plus the Paragraph 12 exception in 22.1 (Transfers under 12.13-12.14 to a Party's Subsidiary, Parent Company or Affiliate) give every other Party consent-free assignment and Transfer routes, consent under 22.2 runs to the Management Committee rather than to us, and there is no bar on transfers to our competitors. Curing at the fallback would mean giving up our own affiliate/parent carve-outs, so we target preferred and add one Subparagraph 22.7 that overrides Paragraph 12 and Subparagraphs 22.2-22.5 for other Parties, requires our prior written consent (not unreasonably withheld), bars any transfer to a competitor of ours, and confirms that a change of control of Teleglobe USA Inc. (a signatory of this Agreement) gives no other Party a termination right; no such right exists today, so that sentence is declaratory. Negotiation exposure: other Parties will read the consent right as a unilateral veto and may demand reciprocity.

mappings.element: Customer may assign to an affiliate without consent.

mappings.element: Customer may assign to a successor in a merger, acquisition, or sale of substantially all assets without consent.
Vendor may not assign without Customer's consent.
Customer's consent to Vendor assignment is not to be unreasonably withheld.
Vendor may never assign to a Customer competitor.
Customer's change of control gives Vendor no termination right.

proposal.summary: Add Subparagraph 22.7 overriding Paragraph 12 and Subparagraphs 22.2-22.5 so that other Parties need Teleglobe's consent (not unreasonably withheld), may never transfer to our competitor, and confirming no change-of-control termination right.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Paragraph 22.1 excepts Paragraph 12 and Subparagraphs 22.2-22.5, so today every other Party has consent-free assignment and Transfer routes; new Subparagraph 22.7 overrides both routes to require our prior written consent (not to be unreasonably withheld), bars any assignment, sale or Transfer to a competitor of ours, and confirms that a change of control of Teleglobe USA Inc. gives no other Party a termination right. Our own rights under 22.3-22.5 and Paragraph 12 are untouched; we expect other Parties to press for reciprocity, and we can accept a mutual formulation if needed.

ops.text: Notwithstanding Paragraph 12 and Subparagraphs 22.2, 22.3, 22.4 and 22.5, no Party other than Teleglobe USA Inc. may assign, sell or transfer the whole or any part of its rights or obligations under this Agreement, including any Transfer under Paragraph 12, without the prior written consent of Teleglobe USA Inc., which must not be unreasonably withheld, and no such assignment, sale or transfer may be made to a competitor of Teleglobe USA Inc. A change of control of Teleglobe USA Inc. does not give any other Party any right to terminate this Agreement or Teleglobe USA Inc.'s participation in it.
